description: This Java source file defines the class TraverseSubContentTransform, a Freemarker TemplateTransformModel implementation that handles traversing sub-content in the OFBiz content management system. It processes content nodes, applies filtering conditions, and renders content based on specific context parameters, supporting templating workflows.

classes.name: TraverseSubContentTransform
classes.description: Implements a Freemarker TemplateTransformModel to traverse and process sub-content nodes, applying filters and rendering content based on context.

methods.name: getWriter
methods.description: Creates and returns a Writer that processes sub-content traversal, filtering, and rendering within the Freemarker template environment.

methods.name: checkWhen
methods.description: Determines if a content node satisfies specified conditions to be selected during traversal.

methods.name: populateContext
methods.description: Populates template context variables based on the current node trail.
